entities.summary: Vladimir Antonov was a Russian architect who worked for most of his career in Kumanovo, Macedonia in the beginning of the 20th century. He was a member of the White Guardians and became a White émigré in the Kingdom of Yugoslavia. He was elected as municipal engineer in 1925 to implement the First Regulation Plan of Kumanovo from 1923.
